text_block_list.text: (UOOOOOOH!!!!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I still remember it even now. That 
deafening roar of cheers and screams—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
—The Derby. Tokyo Racecourse, where Dad 
took me for the very first time when I was 
just a kid.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Everyone running out there was dead 
serious. 'I won't hand over this win!' 
'Get out of my way!' 'First place is 
mine!'

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Radiating that kind of aura, charging down 
the final stretch. Side by side, trading 
shoulder bumps.
(UOOOOOOOOOOH!!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
On the ride back, holding onto the back of 
Dad's bike, I was shouting at the top of 
my lungs without even knowing why.

text_block_list.name: Young Vodka
text_block_list.text: Pops! I'm... I'm also gonna...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"I wanna become a cool Umamusume just like 
that too!!"

Starting today, our challenge for the 
Twinkle Series with Vodka begins.

Even if she acts like a delinquent, her 
passion for racing is the real deal. She's 
probably around here today too...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Hm, Trainer? Hey there, partner.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Keep ya waitin'? Starting today, we're 
taking on the Twinkle Series, right?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Of course I am! I've been waiting for this 
day! So I can tear it up right from the 
opening race—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
And that's how I was cruising along the 
slope. Leaving the gale-force winds in the 
dust...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that was pretty slick just now! Right? 
Right? Did I look cool?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Hehe, right, right? Hehehe...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Wait, this is no time to be grinning. The 
most intense series yet is finally about 
to begin.

"First, the two of us decide to confirm 
our concrete goals."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: A concrete goal, huh...? Let's see...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, I wanna be cool! The coolest 
Umamusume there is!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
So make sure it looks cool! Give me some 
totally awesome advice!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Specifically, something like this, I 
suppose...
choice_data_list: Could you be a bit more specific...?

text_block_list.text:
"You've only been giving cool-sounding 
answers for a while now. When I ask if 
there's anything else—"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I told you there is! First off—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I wanna run in the Derby! I wanna clash 
with those bloodshot-eyed rivals on that 
fiery stage!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: And then...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"The strongest senior—Narita Brian. I want 
her to acknowledge me."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
She beat me pretty easily in the mock race 
last time, but I want to make her think, 
"Not bad." And besides...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"...Aside from that, well, I guess there's 
one more trivial thing."
choice_data_list: What do you mean by "I don't really care"?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I wanna shut that annoying jerk up, the 
one who gets in my face every chance she 
gets. That '#1 idiot.'

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Who are you calling the biggest idiot?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I want to be number one, what's wrong with 
that?! Aren't you a "cool idiot" too?!

(Daiwa Scarlet. Always aiming for number 
one, she's Vodka's rival.)

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
To think you'd be debuting in the Twinkle 
Series right around the same time as me...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: You always copy me so fast.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hah, as if I'd ever copy you! It's just a 
coincidence we matched, alright?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Listen up. If you get in the way of my 
conquest, I will crush you without mercy.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Just try it if you think you can! I'm 
gonna make sure you suffer the most 
humiliating defeat imaginable!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Today's the last day for talkin' smack. 
Starting tomorrow, we settle things on the 
track."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Hmph, I know. See ya.

Daiwa Scarlet stalked off with squared, 
angry shoulders.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Well, while we're making you look cool, 
let's shut that guy up too.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Alright, today marks the first run of the 
year.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
You watchin', Pops? I'm finally making my 
debut.

Looking at the sky, she grinned. Yet, her 
eyes sparkled like those of a young boy.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Alright, then today is our anniversary. 
Enough chit-chat, let's—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Let's go for a run on the mountain pass. 
We'll tear through the corners and head 
straight for the scenic peak!
choice_data_list:
The mountain pass...? Did you have a 
motorcycle?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Of course I don't! I'd love to have one, 
but there's no way I can afford it. That's 
why—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I'm runnin' on these two legs! It's just 
right for training! HRAAAAH!

With her tail streaming behind her, Vodka 
sprinted away at full power...

A pure-hearted delinquent Umamusume. She 
cares only about being cool, and has an 
outrageous personality, but—

I don't want her to stay small-minded. Let 
her run freely and raise her into a grand, 
large-scale Umamusume.
